technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and multiple oscillator confirmations, but overbought conditions (RSI 9, Stoch K) and weak ADX trend strength limit swing entry probability; better suited for profit-taking than new longs.

fundamental.summary: CB shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 26 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for CB; congressional activity is stale (134+ days old), market sentiment is balanced neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (310) with imminent NFP event in 1 day creates severe near-term volatility risk; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 26 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish confirmation and RSI momentum rising suggests structural uptrend intact despite overbought readings.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (310), imminent NFP volatility, RSI 9 overbought at 71.78, weak ADX trend strength (10.99), zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 26 days create a hostile risk/reward environment for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure remains bullish with price above all major MAs, but overbought RSI (71.78) and weak ADX (10.99) signal exhaustion rather than continuation; entry quality is moderate at best.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (310) combined with imminent NFP event in 1 day creates severe near-term volatility that will likely trigger stops before swing thesis develops; earnings in 26 days adds secondary timing risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
